name: Contouring Discrete Indicator Functions
aliases: Area-Preserving Contouring for Discrete Indicator Functions
definition: A contouring method for Discrete Indicator Functions (DIF) that replaces the linear interpolation of vertex positions in Marching Cubes with a solution that ensures the area (in 2D) or projected area (in 3D) inside the contour matches the occupancy values of the cells. It assumes samples are located at cell centers and connects them with a dual grid.
summary: Contouring Discrete Indicator Functions is a surface extraction method that eliminates aliasing artifacts by replacing linear interpolation with an area-matching interpolant tailored for discontinuous volume fraction data.
